overview: This House resolution assigns two members to House committees. It puts Representative Fine on the Committee on Foreign Affairs, and names Representative Garbarino as chair of the Committee on Homeland Security. Committee assignments decide which lawmakers write and review bills in each policy area, and resolutions like this are a routine way the House fills open seats. The House approved it on July 22, 2025.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step that keeps committees fully staffed and gives the Homeland Security Committee a chair so its work can continue.
against: Critics say it is an internal housekeeping matter that does not change any law or policy.
